niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers light, neutral interfaces with soft purple, gray, or muted pink accents over dark, high-contrast, neon, or heavily saturated themes. They favor clear hierarchy, organized sectioning, explicit labels, and readable grouped content. They like layouts that feel spacious or neatly balanced, with low visual clutter, restrained depth, and flatter presentation. They prefer calm, polished, structured screens over flashy, promotional, or icon-dominated ones. They also favor explicit, text-labeled actions and statuses, soft rounded components, and selective accent usage rather than aggressive emphasis.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds with soft purple, gray, pink, or muted accents; rejects dark navy or black interfaces, neon accents, and stronger high-contrast color schemes.
Prefers strong visual hierarchy with clear section titles, centered or prominent headings, readable grouping, aligned metadata, and organized row or card structure.
Prefers simplified, organized, balanced compositions with fewer competing elements, less visual noise, and stronger structural clarity.
Prefers flatter, minimalist, polished presentation with subtle dividers, restrained shadows, and low visual pressure rather than heavy cards, raised depth, or flashy styling.
Prefers clearly labeled actions, obvious form affordances, explicit status labels, numbered guidance, and text-supported controls over icon-only, ambiguous, or overly compact indicators.
Prefers layouts with either spacious separation or compact rows when they improve scanability, but consistently rejects cramped stacking, uneven spacing, and bulky padding that reduces clarity.
Prefers softer rounded cards, contained icons or badges, muted emphasis, and supportive trust cues rather than oversized icons, boxy components, or aggressive button emphasis.
